$comment: Decision library for demo seeding, fixtures and evaluation. One Confluence page per entry (label tether-decision). 'constraints' are the gold constraints the LLM extractor should produce. Names are fictional.

decisions.title: Payment retry policy (2024)
decisions.statement: The payment service retries failed transactions up to 5 times before marking them as failed.
decisions.rationale: Early gateway integration was flaky; generous retries kept the success rate acceptable.

constraints.label: retry limit
constraints.quote: The payment service retries failed transactions up to 5 times

decisions.title: Payment retry policy
decisions.statement: The payment service must retry failed transactions no more than 3 times. A retry is any request after the initial attempt; the initial attempt is not counted. Retries use exponential backoff.
decisions.rationale: Retry storms during the March 2026 gateway incident doubled upstream load. Three retries recover almost all transient failures.

constraints.label: retry limit
constraints.quote: The payment service must retry failed transactions no more than 3 times.

decisions.title: Idempotency keys for payment creation
decisions.statement: Every payment creation request must include an idempotency key so that retries never create duplicate charges.
decisions.rationale: Duplicate charges are the most expensive support issue we have.

constraints.label: idempotency key
constraints.quote: Every payment creation request must include an idempotency key

decisions.title: Card data storage
decisions.statement: The payment service must not persist full card numbers (PAN). Only the gateway token and the last four digits may be stored.
decisions.rationale: Keeps the service out of PCI DSS storage scope.

constraints.label: full card number storage
constraints.quote: The payment service must not persist full card numbers (PAN).

decisions.title: Payment gateway timeout
decisions.statement: Calls from the payment service to the payment gateway must time out after at most 10 seconds.
decisions.rationale: Checkout UX budget is 15 seconds end to end.

constraints.label: gateway timeout
constraints.quote: Calls from the payment service to the payment gateway must time out after at most 10 seconds.

decisions.title: Webhook retry backoff
decisions.statement: Webhook deliveries should use exponential backoff starting at 2 seconds.

constraints.label: webhook retry backoff
constraints.quote: Webhook deliveries should use exponential backoff starting at 2 seconds.

decisions.title: Refund approval threshold
decisions.statement: In production, refunds above 10,000 USD must be approved manually; only refunds up to 10,000 USD may be auto-approved.
decisions.rationale: Fraud controls required by the finance team.

constraints.label: refund auto-approval limit
constraints.quote: only refunds up to 10,000 USD may be auto-approved

decisions.title: Payment log retention
decisions.statement: Payment service logs must be retained for 90 days.
decisions.rationale: Chargeback disputes can arrive up to 90 days after a payment.

constraints.label: log retention
constraints.quote: Payment service logs must be retained for 90 days.

decisions.title: Customer data log retention
decisions.statement: Logs that contain customer data must be retained for no more than 30 days, in every service.
decisions.rationale: Data minimisation requirement from the privacy review.

constraints.label: log retention
constraints.quote: Logs that contain customer data must be retained for no more than 30 days
